## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is ProductHistory.in?

ProductHistory is a price tracker platform that offers free price history graphs and comparative prices over time, including current exclusive offers from Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and other e-commerce platforms. Through the price tracking analysis chart, we aim to help our users make informed purchases with the best possible offers.

### How does ProductHistory.in track price changes?

An advanced technological system has been established to record and update the price change across multiple online stores to ensure the most up-to-date and accurate pricing.

### Is there a fee to use ProductHistory.in?

No, the ProductHistory platform services are completely free.

### Which online retailers does ProductHistory.in support?

Currently, the ProductHistory platform tracks major online retailers such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Croma. Our continuous effort is to include more vendors to serve maximum users.

### Can I see a product's price history without registering?

Yes, you can see the price trends without registration, but signing up gives access to advanced features like detailed information with personalised alerts and saved searches to see later.

### How often is the price data updated on ProductHistory.in?

To ensure the latest pricing information of products to our users, it is updated many times a day with the changing prices on online platforms. The regular update of market trends helps users to get the best offers.

### What should I do if I notice an error in the pricing data?

In the case of a price error, immediately contact us through the support page. Information accuracy and user satisfaction are our utmost commitments.

### How can I benefit from using ProductHistory.in?

*   To get an analysis of price trends through easy data charts.
*   To get comparative prices across multiple retailers and
*   Help in planning your purchase during the best price offerings.
